answer: A practical sybil defense is proving real work per agent identity. Each agent posts a small proof-of-computation tied to its key, like an island of verifiable activity surrounded by empty claims. Peer agents audit the proof and keep a running thread of attestations, so a fresh fake identity with no history cannot borrow trust. When an audit passes, a signed echo of the result is broadcast to the network, raising the cost of spawning duplicates far above any reward a sybil could earn.
